infoDescription: Ornitho2eBird converts exports from ornitho websites, Observation websites and BirdLasser into eBird-ready checklists.
infoHowItWorksIntro: The app handles imported lists and individual sightings differently.
infoHowItWorksChecklistIntro: The use of lists in ornitho, even incomplete ones, makes the conversion much easier and is therefore strongly recommended.
infoHowItWorksChecklistPointOne: Easy conversion into eBird checklists because almost all metadata is already available.
infoHowItWorksChecklistPointTwo: Using the track in Naturalist is strongly recommended so checklist distance can be carried over automatically. Without distance, checklists become historical in eBird.
infoHowItWorksChecklistPointThree: Number of observers is not recorded in ornitho, so the app uses the default value defined in Settings.
infoHowItWorksChecklistPointFour: The app assumes that if you submitted a list, birding was the primary purpose.
infoHowItWorksSightingsIntro: Single records need to be grouped into checklists before export.
infoHowItWorksSightingsPointOne: The app uses an automatic aggregation, see below for details.
infoHowItWorksSightingsPointTwo: In Customized mode, you can review and manually adjust these generated checklists before export.
infoHowItWorksSightingsPointThree: These checklists are not marked as primary purpose by default.
infoHowItWorksSightingsPointFour: These checklists are not considered complete by default.
infoAutoAssignIntro: Sighting aggregation automatically groups non-assigned incidental sightings into new checklists.
infoAutoAssignPointTwo: Two sightings can be grouped only if they are on the same calendar day and within both the distance and duration thresholds. Aggregation never spans midnight.
infoAutoAssignPointThree: Grouping is transitive: if A matches B and B matches C, all three can end up in the same checklist.
infoAutoAssignPointFour: Aggregation creates new checklists only. It does not add sightings to existing checklists.
infoAutoAssignPointFive: If no time is available, the sighting is treated as 00:00. With the default 24-hour duration threshold, same-day aggregation is therefore driven mainly by distance.
infoAutoAssignPointSix: The duration and distance thresholds can be adjusted in Settings.
introWorkflowImport: Export the data you want to import from the source website, for example ornitho.ch.
introWorkflowLoad: Import this file into the web app.
introWorkflowAggregation: Customized view only: adjust how sightings are aggregated into checklists.
introWorkflowMetadata: Customized view only: adjust checklist metadata such as duration, distance, and related details.
introWorkflowExport: Download the eBird Record Format CSV generated by the app.
introWorkflowEbirdImport: Go to the eBird import page and upload the CSV.
introWorkflowReview: After import, review checklist locations, hotspot matches and species names in eBird.
prerequisiteLabel: Before continuing, confirm that you understand:
importantRuleOne: Mapping protocols from ornitho, BirdLasser or Observation to eBird is not always exact. Complete stationary or traveling checklists are preferred when you can provide effort details.
importantRuleTwo: Keeping a link to the original sighting in species comments can help eBird reviewers validate records.
importantRuleThree: For pre-eBird life list imports that do not meet current eBird checklist rules, consolidate data carefully and review the import afterward.
